parameters.name: level
parameters.description: The packaging level, lowest first EACH < INNER < CASE < PALLET.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Client-generated key, 1 to 128 printable ASCII characters, one per logical submit (a retry reuses it). The key is global. A repeat with the same method, path and body replays the stored answer (header Idempotency-Replayed: true) only when the first answer was final for that request: a success; a refusal that cannot change for the same request (malformed or invalid fields, gtin-already-assigned, duplicate-listing, feed-already-applied, ...); or negative-availability, whose FAILED feed is kept together with the stored 422. A refusal that the same request can pass later is NOT stored and its key is released, so the same key runs the request again: concurrent-update, not-found, pack-level-not-found, illegal-transition, node-not-sellable, validation-failed and listing-not-on-node (the FAILED feed it recorded stays visible at GET /inventory-feeds/{feedId} until a retry applies it). A 5xx is never stored either. A different request under a released key is a new request; the same key with a different request while the first answer is stored is 409 idempotency-key-reused. A missing key is 400 idempotency-key-required, a malformed one 400 idempotency-key-invalid. Keys are kept for 24 hours.
